articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
articles.description: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
articles.description: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
articles.description: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
articles.description: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
articles.description: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.
articles.author: Marina Temkin

articles.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
articles.description: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
articles.author: Jagmeet Singh

articles.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
articles.description: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
articles.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
articles.description: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
articles.description: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.
articles.author: Sarah Perez
